text.p: Evans Inc, a fur and apparel retail chain, said Friday it completed its acquisition of the assets of Triomphe Fourrures Inc, which are used in connection with the operation of the Maximilian Fur Salons in Bloomingdale's Stores.

The total purchase price was $5.4 million, which includes inventory and operating assets as well as the worldwide fur trademark of Maximilian. The purchase was for cash, payable in installments through December 30, 1999.
Evans also entered into a new, multi-year license agreement with Bloomingdale's to operate 16 fur salons across the country under the Maximilian at Bloomingdale's name.
The company said it also amended its loan agreement to increase its credit facility to $35.0 million from $27.0 million.
